title: agents.attach_receipt.get request
description: P086: MCP request schema for agents.attach_receipt.get. Fetches the provider-session attach receipt for a resurrection continuation. Only Operator principals (scoped to the continuation's run) receive the raw receipt; Reviewer principals receive a redacted projection; Guest principals receive only an existence indicator.

continuation_id.description: UUID of the provider_session_resurrection continuation whose attach receipt to fetch.

run_id.description: UUID of the run that owns this continuation. Used for run-scoped authorization; requests from principals not scoped to this run receive auth_failure.
